result.reason: The redline removes the stated three-year take-or-pay commitment, but permits unrestricted minimum commitments in future Order Forms. Those commitments need not be limited to the current 12-month term or reducible on 30 days’ notice, so the language reaches neither the preferred position nor the fallback. The additional suspension and release provisions are unnecessary to implement the preferred position, and phrases such as “credit all amounts paid” and “suspended or released pro rata” are ambiguous.
